crystalbeam.name: Crystal Beam
crystalbeam.desc: A beam of crystalline energy. High critical-hit ratio.

crystalpulse.name: Crystal Pulse
crystalpulse.desc: A powerful pulse of crystalline energy. May lower target Sp. Def.
crystalpulse.shortDesc: Crystal pulse. 30% chance to lower Sp. Def.

cosmicpulse.name: Cosmic Pulse
cosmicpulse.desc: A pulse of cosmic energy that may confuse the target.

cosmicblast.name: Cosmic Blast
cosmicblast.desc: A blast of cosmic energy. Hits even in the dark.

cosmicshock.name: Cosmic Shock
cosmicshock.desc: A shockwave of cosmic energy that always hits.

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.desc: Stars rain down on the target. May lower accuracy.
starfall.shortDesc: Stellar stars. 30% chance to lower accuracy.

starfallstrike.name: Starfall Strike
starfallstrike.desc: The user strikes with the force of falling stars. High chance to flinch.
